searches.title: Keyword searches
searches.description: Amazon.com searches whose products you want the sellers of, e.g. yoga mat, "phone case", supplements.

listingUrls.title: Listing URLs
listingUrls.description: Amazon.com bestseller, category or search URLs, e.g. https://www.amazon.com/Best-Sellers-Kitchen-Dining/zgbs/kitchen.

asins.title: Products (ASINs or URLs)
asins.description: Get every third-party seller of these products, e.g. B085DVHQ57 or https://www.amazon.com/dp/B085DVHQ57.

sellerIds.title: Seller IDs or profile URLs
sellerIds.description: Look these sellers up directly, e.g. A3EQJ16CEAAUOF or https://www.amazon.com/sp?seller=A3EQJ16CEAAUOF.

maxProductsPerSearch.title: Products per search or listing
maxProductsPerSearch.description: How many products from each search or listing to check for sellers. Each product usually has 2-10 sellers.

pagesPerSearch.title: Pages per search
pagesPerSearch.description: Amazon search pages to read per keyword (about 50 products each).

sellerCountries.title: Seller countries
sellerCountries.description: Keep only sellers registered in these countries (two-letter codes), e.g. US, CA, GB. Empty = any. Filtered sellers are not charged.

minRatings12Months.title: Min ratings (last 12 months)
minRatings12Months.description: Skip sellers with fewer feedback ratings than this in the last 12 months. 0 = no minimum.

requireBusinessAddress.title: Only sellers with published business details
requireBusinessAddress.description: Skip sellers whose profile shows no business name and address. Skipped sellers are not charged.
